summary: This Form 6-K filed by ArcelorMittal (Luxembourg) reports the issuance of $1 billion in 5.375% senior unsecured notes due 2036 under a supplemental indenture. It is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing includes the indenture terms, redemption provisions, and change-of-control put option. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign is described.
